entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Perf regression: mvc, tls-renegotiation-httpsys #63419
  • Using PolicySchemeOptions.ForwardDefaultSelector to forward to Microsoft Identity OIDC results in infinite recursion #63418
  • Unable to implement SignalR Hub on IIS with windows authentification, works fine with IIS Express, negotiate fails 401 ! #63412
  • Update 17.14.12 broke everything #63411

Closed

  • Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds (a[href$="Downloads/"]): A11y_ASP.NETCore_Index_AI4W. #62856
  • Perf regression: ApiCrudListProducts, ApiCrudListProducts #63026
  • [Perf] Slow E2E tests due to unrecycled chrome instances #56004
  • `ETag header not found` error when running release build of app with compressed resources #63364
    10.0-rc2
  • Perf regression: fortunes #63402
  • Perf regression: fortunes_dapper #63405
  • Perf regression: kestrel-hostheader-mismatch #63410
  • MultipartReader failed with IOException #63403
  • Update OpenTelemetry semantic conventions to include AuthN/AuthZ metrics #60468
  • Missing documentation of breaking change in .NET 6 #60887
    Backlog
  • public virtual async Task StopAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) #63416
  • Option to generate x-enum-varnames and x-enum-descriptions #63223
  • MapOpenApi writes invalid json if example contains OpenApiDouble and CurrentCulture formats doubles with comma #60628
  • Support the new QUERY HTTP method #61089
  • Obsoleting Razor Runtime Compilation Recommendations #63001
  • Quarantine Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.RevalidatingServerAuthenticationStateProviderTest.SuppliesCancellationTokenThatSignalsWhenRevalidationLoopIsBeingDiscarded #60472
    10.0-rc2
  • Quarantine Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Rendering.RendererSynchronizationContextTest.Post_CanRunAsynchronously_WhenBusy_Exception #61639
    10.0-rc2
  • Extremely long build times when Debugging after upgrading to v9.0. #59129

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0] Emit validation info for types that have IValidatableObject interface and no validation attributes #63415
    Servicing-consider, 10.0-rc2
  • Emit validation info for types that have IValidatableObject interface and no validation attributes #63414
    area-blazor, area-minimal, feature-validation

Merged

  • Fix Directory Browser accessibility #63393
    area-middleware, 11.0-preview1
  • [Static Assets] Consume `original-resource` instead of the `Etag` #63379
    feature-static-web-assets, area-middleware, 11.0-preview1
  • Unquarantine RevalidatingServerAuthenticationStateProviderTest.SuppliesCancellationTokenThatSignalsWhenRevalidationLoopIsBeingDiscarded #63399
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview1
  • Unquarantine RendererSynchronizationContextTest.Post_CanRunAsynchronously_WhenBusy_Exception #63400
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview1

Updated

  • [release/10.0-rc2] Don't add "unknown" to Blazor metrics tags when values are null #63383
    Servicing-consider, area-blazor, 10.0-rc2
  • [release/10.0] [Static Assets] Consume `original-resource` instead of the `Etag` #63397
    Servicing-consider, 10.0-rc2
  • Add Changelog for SignalR typescript client #63392
    area-signalr
  • Improve enhanced navigation suppression in tests #63132
    area-blazor, tell-mode, test-fixed, 10.0-rc2
